label: retailer sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: The shop refused every Add to cart with an error asking to close the tab and turn off browser extensions, which looks like protection against automated browsers. Not counted as an accessibility result.

reclassified.why: The shop refused every Add to cart with an error asking to close the tab and turn off browser extensions, which looks like protection against automated browsers.

findings.problem: After pressing the decline-all cookie button the whole page tree became empty for a moment with no announcement, so I had to re-read to know whether the banner was gone.
Each product has several links with the same name; the first one with that name cannot take keyboard focus, so I had to try the second or third one by trial and error to open a product.
Product tiles list many color swatch links named only with color combinations and nothing says they are color options, adding long noise before the price.

The size radios were missing from the tree on first load and only appeared later; the page showed Add to cart with no size choice, so it was unclear a size was needed. Out-of-stock size is only marked disabled, and a low-stock message appeared as an alert only after focus moved.

Pressing Add to cart (with a size selected) opened a dialog with an unlabeled-looking error: it said the request could not be completed and told me to close the tab and disable browser extensions. No clear reason, no retry button, and the cart stayed empty. It happened on two different products, so I could not reach checkout.

The error dialog first appeared in the tree as an unnamed button, an empty heading and empty paragraphs, so the message was not readable until I re-read the page. The cart link still says 0 items and the Ver cesta link leads to an empty cart.
Cart page says no items and the checkout button is disabled, with no explanation that the earlier add failed.
